userStories.title: Implement screen capture and LZ4 delta encoding module
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement the screen capture module using Windows DXGI Desktop Duplication API and the LZ4-based delta frame compression.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement DXGI screen capture that grabs current desktop frame
Implement tile-based delta frame detection (64x64 tiles, XXH32 hash)
Implement LZ4 compression for delta regions
Implement full frame fallback when >30% tiles changed
cargo build passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Implemented DxgiCapture via Windows DXGI Desktop Duplication (with cfg(windows) guard and non-Windows stub), tile-based delta detection (64x64, XXH32), LZ4 compression/decompression for delta regions and full frames, full-frame fallback at 30% threshold. All 50 tests pass across all crates.

userStories.title: Implement input capture and host injection module
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement client-side keyboard/mouse event capture and host-side input injection using Windows low-level APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement client-side keyboard event capture (GetAsyncKeyState polling)

Implement input event serialization with timestamps and sequence numbers
Implement host-side input injection via SendInput API
cargo build passes
userStories.notes: Completed: Implemented client/src/input.rs (InputCapture with GetAsyncKeyState polling for all VK codes, GetCursorPos for mouse tracking, timestamp+sequence number serialization) and host/src/input.rs (InputInjector with SendInput for keyboard/mouse/scroll injection). Added Win32_UI_Input_KeyboardAndMouse and Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging workspace features. All 57 tests pass across all crates (2 client, 39 common, 16 host).
